title: SDP answers omit negotiated RTCP feedback
test: tests/whip.test.js: 'WHIP parser reads a=rtcp-fb for one payload type and for the * wildcard', 'WHIP answer carries every offered feedback for the accepted payload type', 'WHIP answer leaves out the forced feedback the offer did not ask for', 'WHIP answer applies a * wildcard to the accepted payload type, for what the producer supports', 'WHIP answer lists feedback once when the offer gives it for the payload type and with *', 'WHIP answer takes feedback only from the accepted payload type, never from another or from RTX', 'WHIP answer gives a rejected section no a=rtcp-fb' (plus 'WHIP answer has no a=rtcp-fb when the offer lists no feedback', a guard that passed before the fix)
proof: Before the fix, node --test tests/whip.test.js failed 7 of 18 (the 10 existing tests and the no-feedback guard passed). With a H.264 offer carrying a=rtcp-fb:96 goog-remb, transport-cc, ccm fir, nack and nack pli, the answer's video section had no a=rtcp-fb line (expected 5, actual []), and the same for partial feedback (offer nack + nack pli: expected ['96 nack', '96 nack pli'], actual []), for '*' wildcard feedback (expected nack, nack pli, ccm fir; actual []) and for an Opus section with a=rtcp-fb:111 transport-cc. The parser also dropped a=rtcp-fb:* lines (its pattern only matched digits): parsed.video.rtcpFb held 1 of 3 entries. After the fix the parser keeps '*' entries as payloadType '*', and createAnswer writes, after a=rtpmap and before a=fmtp, one a=rtcp-fb:<pt> <type>[ <parameter>] line for each entry that the offer lists for the accepted payload type or with '*' AND that the producer is configured with (the list toMediasoupRtpParameters passes to transport.produce(): the payload type's own offered feedback, plus for video the forced nack, nack pli and ccm fir). Entries come once each, in the producer's order. The forced types are not answered unless offered; a '*' entry the producer is not configured for (transport-cc, goog-remb on video; anything on audio) is not answered; feedback offered only for another payload type or for an RTX payload type is never answered, since the answer lists only the accepted codec's payload type; rejected sections carry none. fmtp lines are unchanged. Producer rtpParameters were compared against the unchanged lib/whip.js on 28 offers (video feedback absent, partial, full, duplicated, on another payload type, wildcard, with odd spacing, each with four audio variants): deepEqual in every case. All 18 tests in tests/whip.test.js pass; full suite 513 of 513; lint and typecheck pass.
